description: This file contains an in-memory implementation of the IMembershipTable and IGatewayListProvider interfaces for testing purposes within the Orleans framework, specifically implementing methods to manage and query membership and gateway data.

classes.name: InProcessMembershipTable
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of IMembershipTable and IGatewayListProvider for testing, managing silo membership data with operations for reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up entries.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A private nested class within InProcessMembershipTable that manages the storage and manipulation of membership entries using a thread-safe dictionary and versioning.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table; in this implementation, it's a no-op.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the membership table for the specified cluster ID if it matches the internal cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads the membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Attempts to insert a new membership entry if no entry exists for the given silo address and version matches.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Attempts to update an existing membership entry if the ETag and version match.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a given membership entry.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silo entries that are marked as Dead and have an IAmAlive time older than the specified date.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider; here it's a no-op.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns a list of gateway URIs for all active silos with non-zero proxy ports.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specific silo.
